description: Single compact fantasy RPG skill icon, crisp 16-bit pixel art, bold clean dark outline, 3 shades per color, simple readable silhouette, centered with 5 pixel empty margin, no frame, no letters, transparent background. A squat purple glass debuff potion bottle with a cork stopper, and one large bold downward pointing violet arrow in front at lower right. Purple liquid, pale lavender glass highlights. Clearly readable downward arrow. No skull, no text.
